cycle.goal_title: Cut Dave's hours in the business from 58 to 35 a week
cycle.goal_why: A buyer pays less for a business that stops when the owner stops. Taking quoting and scheduling off Dave is the fastest way to show it doesn't.

kpis.name: Owner hours a week
kpis.how_measured: Measured from the timesheet Dave fills in each Friday. This is the number the whole cycle is judged on.

kpis.name: Quotes sent without Dave
kpis.how_measured: A leading indicator, counted from the quotes inbox. When quoting moves off Dave, his hours follow a few weeks later.

kpis.name: Jobs scheduled by Sean
kpis.how_measured: A leading indicator. Counted from ServiceM8: jobs booked or moved by Sean, divided by all jobs that week.

plan_pairs.problem: Every quote over $5k waits for Dave, so jobs stall when he's on the tools or away.
plan_pairs.initiative: Build a quoting playbook and pricing matrix so Priya can quote up to $15k on her own.

plan_pairs.problem: The schedule lives in Dave's head and phone. Nobody else can move a job.
plan_pairs.initiative: Move every job into ServiceM8 and make Sean the owner of the schedule.

plan_pairs.problem: There are no written decision rights, so the team's default answer is "ask Dave".
plan_pairs.initiative: Agree who decides what, and start a 30-minute weekly leadership meeting Dave doesn't run.

months.summary: Log two weeks of Dave's time and map every task he does to the person who should own it.
Hand quoting to Priya and scheduling to Sean, with Dave reviewing rather than doing.
months.goal: 42 hours and 60% of quotes without Dave.

months.summary: Decision rights live, leadership meeting running, then a two-week test with Dave away.
months.goal: 35 hours and a clean two weeks away.

weeks.asset: Owner time audit, second week of logs

weeks.meeting: Progress review: test each asset against the numbers
Debrief and plan the next 90 days

assets.name: Owner Exit Map v1
assets.description: Every task Dave does, how many hours it takes, and who takes it over. Built from two weeks of time logs.

assets.name: Quoting playbook and pricing matrix
assets.description: Step-by-step quoting process plus price bands by job type, so quotes up to $15k don't need Dave.

assets.name: Decision Rights Matrix
assets.description: Who decides, who approves and who just needs to know, for the 30 decisions that come up most.

assets.name: Scheduling SOP
assets.description: How Sean builds, changes and confirms the weekly schedule in ServiceM8.

assets.name: Leadership meeting rhythm
assets.description: A 30-minute weekly agenda and scorecard review Priya runs, so decisions happen without Dave in the room.

actions.title: Quote five jobs over $5k without Dave and log the time each takes
Move every October job into the ServiceM8 schedule
Forward all quote requests to the quotes inbox instead of answering them
Record Loom feedback on Priya's quoting SOP draft
Draft the decision-rights matrix for Thursday

parked.text: The council maintenance contract is 24% of revenue.
Management accounts come quarterly from the bookkeeper, not monthly from Xero.
parked.category: Numbers a buyer can rely on

parked.text: Second apprentice intake and a fourth van.
parked.category: Growth, after the business can run without Dave
